Verified players are sourced from public reporting and/or sources close to Capology. Unverified players are estimated using Capology’s algorithms that factor in every club's personnel costs from official financial statements and/or UEFA publications. In some cases, unverified players are sourced from reporting that has not been duly confirmed. Inactive players could have terminated contracts or are currently out on loan. Players on loan may have multiple salary estimates, representing the division of salary between the player's former and current clubs. Historical salary coverage may be limited or incomplete.
